positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Taught 600+ students the principles of scalable software design by exploring 3-tiered architecture (frontend, backend, database), reusable components, and CAP theorem

Mentored students to build cloud-native, fault-tolerant software projects using AWS infrastructure, Docker containers, network APIs, and CI/CD automated deployment pipelines
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Distributed File System (DFS)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Built product features and tooling to accurately determine and communicate the Estimated Delivery Date of an item to the customer

volunteerExperiences.description:
